notes: Twin of METRICS.md. Code reads ids, names, units, statuses, prerequisites, reference ranges, plausibility bounds and thresholds from here; algorithms live in METRICS.md.

Revised 2026-09-27 for DECISIONS D1, D4, D5 and D11 (see the METRICS.md revision log). trunk-tilt-band is removed (replaced by shoulder-tilt-trophy); knee-bend-band is rear view only; the side-view audio flight-time speed method is removed.

statusDefault = the status the engine emits when all prerequisites hold and the metric has passed synthetic validation (V1) in that condition class. statusTarget = the status after real-footage validation passes.

validationLevel is stored per condition class (day, overcast, night-lights, flicker). All metrics are V0 until the first synthetic matrix run (METRICS.md section 5) passes; CI then promotes them through a reviewed change.

Emitted status = min(statusTarget, statusCeilingByValidationLevel[validationLevel[conditionClass]]), then the condition cap, then the per-value rules in METRICS.md section 3. Status order: unavailable < experimental < estimated < measured. player-entered is outside the ladder.
Experimental values are hidden unless the profile experimental toggle is on, never appear in headlines, and are never cited by coaching text.

Heights are ball-centre heights. Ratios are of the player standing height. Positive forward = into the court from the start toe (the geometric front toe at toss release). Roles (front foot, wrists, front shoulder, nearer knee) are geometric, never MediaPipe left/right labels.

Plausibility bounds are applied before aggregation regardless of confidence: hardReject excludes the value (IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUE, counted in N but not X); softFlag keeps it with confidence x 0.7 (CHECK_THIS_SERVE).

V2.note: Timing = timingMetricIds. Spatial spreads (spatialSpreadIds) stay estimated until V3 (two-view triangulated SD within 20%), because V2 annotation shares the engine image geometry and cannot see the sideways leak.

serveCountConfirmed.rule: Once the player confirms the serve strip, the session count is emitted as measured; otherwise estimated until V2.

conditionCap.liftedWhen: The metric reaches V1 in that condition class (S4 night-lights and flicker cells pass).
conditionCap.classification: flicker when the flicker check warns; night-lights when the player tags under lights or the subject median luminance is below the initial night threshold set on S4 renders; overcast when the exposure check reports low daylight contrast; otherwise day.

errorModelPlanning.note: Planning values from the pose ROI evaluation (mean joint error 0.024-0.036 BH mirror-tolerant; hitting wrist 0.05-0.15 BH near contact). Replaced by validation/synthetic/<date>/noise.json (METRICS.md section 5.5).
errorModelPlanning.thresholdRule: Every detection threshold >= 3 x the measured cleaned noise of the quantity it tests, with hysteresis where a state can flip. Speeds come from a local quadratic over 7-9 frames.

intrinsicsDefault.basis: sensor long axis, mapped to the displayed orientation after rotation metadata; native intrinsics or videoFieldOfView when available
intrinsicsDefault.fHU: fLong x (long side / displayed height): portrait about 0.75, landscape 16:9 about 1.34

tilt.rectification: K . R(pitch, roll) . K^-1 applied to every keypoint and ball centre before any height, distance or angle

geometry.setupClassRule: portrait -> portrait-near; landscape with camera-to-server distance D >= 8.0 m -> landscape-fence; landscape with D < 8.0 m -> landscape-near; rear view -> rear

depthOffsetPriorsM.note: Toss or contact offset towards a chest-side camera (positive = nearer the camera). Back-side camera flips the sign. The prior sigma is player-persistent (sigma_p). With a proven time base and >= 5 bracketed tosses, a per-session estimate from toss gravity is combined with the prior: delta = D x (1 - s_body / s_grav).

aboveFrameFitted.condition: exit and re-entry through the top edge, >= 3 detections per branch, gap <= 0.65 s, time base proven or physics-fixed

rightCensored.condition: left through the top and not fittable
rightCensored.aggregate: censored at the frame top; > 10% censored -> spread "at least X cm" and median provisional; > 50% -> median unavailable

prerequisiteVocabulary.view:side: Side view on the hitting-arm (chest) side or back side (D1)
prerequisiteVocabulary.fps>=30: Real capture frame rate at least 30 (the single floor)
prerequisiteVocabulary.fps>=60: Real capture frame rate at least 60
prerequisiteVocabulary.fps>=120: Real capture frame rate at least 120
prerequisiteVocabulary.timebase: Time base proven, or fixed by the gravity check (section 2.9)
prerequisiteVocabulary.timebase:proven: Time base proven (speed never uses a physics-fixed time base)
prerequisiteVocabulary.pitch: Camera pitch known from sensors or estimated from background verticals (otherwise PITCH_UNKNOWN downgrades apply)
prerequisiteVocabulary.yaw<=15: Residual camera yaw at most 15 degrees
prerequisiteVocabulary.roles:geometric: Geometric roles assigned (front foot, tossing/hitting wrist, front shoulder, nearer knee); else ROLE_AMBIGUOUS
prerequisiteVocabulary.event:tossApex: tossApex bracketed or fitted above the frame (section 2.4.3)
prerequisiteVocabulary.event:trophy-pelvis: trophy found by the pelvis-min method (not the fallback)
prerequisiteVocabulary.event:contact-ball: contact found with a ball position (not wrist-only)
prerequisiteVocabulary.floor: Floor row found (feet visible in setup)
prerequisiteVocabulary.startToe: Start toe S0 found (geometric front foot index visible at release)
prerequisiteVocabulary.bodyHeight: Standing body height in frame found from upright setup frames (vertical-extent criterion)
prerequisiteVocabulary.playerHeight: Player height entered in Profile (needed for cm, m and km/h)
prerequisiteVocabulary.hips:visible: Both hips visible (>= 0.5) through the loading and drive window
prerequisiteVocabulary.shoulders:visible: Both shoulders visible (>= 0.5) at the key frame
prerequisiteVocabulary.frontLeg:visible: Front-leg hip, knee and ankle visible (>= 0.5) at trophy
prerequisiteVocabulary.nearerKnee:visible: Rear view: nearer-knee hip, knee and ankle visible (>= 0.6) at trophy
prerequisiteVocabulary.segmentLengths: Standing thigh and shank lengths from >= 5 upright frames
prerequisiteVocabulary.n>=5: At least 5 included serves in the stratum
prerequisiteVocabulary.n>=8: At least 8 included serves in the stratum
prerequisiteVocabulary.n>=12: At least 12 included serves in the stratum
prerequisiteVocabulary.n>=16: At least 16 included serves in the stratum and block
prerequisiteVocabulary.baseline:2-sessions: Player-relative band reference: at least 2 matched sessions with >= 8 included serves each (else BASELINE_BUILDING)
prerequisiteVocabulary.block:single: Computed within one recorded block, never across a drill or template-block boundary
prerequisiteVocabulary.history:28d-3sessions: At least 28 days of history and at least 3 sessions
prerequisiteVocabulary.audio: Usable audio (opt-in hit-sound timing; onset timestamps only are kept); used only to time contact, and in the rear view to refine a bounce already located in video
prerequisiteVocabulary.entry:targetZone: Aimed target tagged T, body or wide for this serve (mixed or untagged fails: TARGET_NOT_TAGGED)
prerequisiteVocabulary.entry:secondServeBlock: Block declared as second serves (every serve is a 2nd serve; sequence rule off)
prerequisiteVocabulary.entry:pointPlay: Optional point-play mode (1st/2nd tagged in sequence); deferred in v1
prerequisiteVocabulary.entry:matchLog: D11 match log entry (player-entered; never pooled with practice)
prerequisiteVocabulary.bounce:located: Bounce detected in rear-view video and mapped through the court homography
prerequisiteVocabulary.bounce:coverage>=50%: Bounces located on at least 50% of the serves that went in (session typical only)
prerequisiteVocabulary.toggle:experimental: Experimental metrics toggle on in Profile

VIEW_NOT_SUPPORTED.meaning: This view cannot see the quantity
VIEW_NOT_SUPPORTED.unlockHint: Film from the side, on your hitting-arm side, to see this.
VIEW_NOT_SUPPORTED.unlockHintRearOnly: Add a phone behind you to see this.

VIEW_MISMATCH.meaning: Detected view differs from the declared view
VIEW_MISMATCH.unlockHint: This clip doesn't look like the view you chose. Check where the phone is.

FPS_TOO_LOW.meaning: Below the metric's minimum real frame rate
FPS_TOO_LOW.unlockHint: Record at 60 fps (120 fps or more for speed).

TIME_BASE_UNKNOWN.meaning: Possible rendered slow motion and the gravity check could not fix it; or a metric needing a proven time base has only a physics-fixed one
TIME_BASE_UNKNOWN.unlockHint: Import the original slow-motion file, or record in the app.

FRAMES_DROPPED.meaning: More than 10% of frames missing in the serve window

PLAYER_HEIGHT_MISSING.meaning: A cm, m or km/h value needs the entered height
PLAYER_HEIGHT_MISSING.unlockHint: Add your height in Profile to see centimetres.

BODY_NOT_UPRIGHT.meaning: No standing frames to measure body height
BODY_NOT_UPRIGHT.unlockHint: Stand tall for a second before each serve.

FEET_NOT_VISIBLE.meaning: Foot landmarks missing or cut off
FEET_NOT_VISIBLE.unlockHint: Keep your feet in the frame.

POSE_LOW_QUALITY.meaning: Tracking quality below 0.5 where the metric needs it
POSE_LOW_QUALITY.unlockHint: Make sure you're the only person near your serving spot, with the light behind the camera.

OCCLUDED.meaning: Needed landmark hidden at the event
OCCLUDED.unlockHint: Try the other side of the court so nothing blocks the view.

ROLE_AMBIGUOUS.meaning: A geometric role (front foot, nearer knee, front shoulder) could not be assigned
ROLE_AMBIGUOUS.unlockHint: We couldn't tell your front foot from your back foot on this serve.

BALL_NOT_TRACKED.meaning: Toss track missing or under 6 detections
BALL_NOT_TRACKED.unlockHint: Toss against sky, a fence or a plain windbreak; avoid trees behind you.

APEX_EXTRAPOLATED.meaning: Apex above the frame, fitted with gravity from both branches; kept as estimated with a wider interval
APEX_EXTRAPOLATED.unlockHint: Your toss went above the picture, so its height is estimated. Move the phone back a step to see it all.

APEX_OUT_OF_FRAME.meaning: Apex left the frame and could not be fitted (one branch only, or out for more than 0.65 s); carried as censored
APEX_OUT_OF_FRAME.unlockHint: Move the phone back a step or raise it a little so the whole toss fits.

RELEASE_NOT_FOUND.unlockHint: We couldn't see this moment clearly on this serve.

CONTACT_NOT_FOUND.unlockHint: We couldn't see this moment clearly on this serve.

LANDING_NOT_FOUND.unlockHint: We couldn't see this moment clearly on this serve.

NO_CONTACT.unlockHint: Swing and miss: not counted in contact stats.

AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: Hit-sound timing off (the default) or audio unusable; contact timed from video
AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE.unlockHint: Optional: turn on 'Use the hit sound for timing' for sharper contact timing.

NOT_ENTERED.meaning: Player has not tagged what this needs
NOT_ENTERED.unlockHint: Tag your serves (in, net, long, wide) in review.

TARGET_NOT_TAGGED.meaning: Launch speed needs the aimed target to bound the ball's angle out of the picture (D4)
TARGET_NOT_TAGGED.unlockHint: Tag where you aimed: T, body or wide.

BOUNCE_NOT_LOCATED.meaning: Rear view: bounce not found in the video, or located on too few serves in the block
BOUNCE_NOT_LOCATED.unlockHint: Raise the rear phone so both service boxes are clear. 4K helps.

NEEDS_CALIBRATION.meaning: Rear auto outcomes or rear speed need the four-corner tap
NEEDS_CALIBRATION.unlockHint: Tap the four corners of the service box.

CAMERA_MOVED.unlockHint: Fix the phone firmly; it moved during recording.

CAMERA_TILTED.meaning: Measured pitch or roll above 5 degrees (8 after the tilt test), or yaw above 15 degrees
CAMERA_TILTED.unlockHint: Keep the phone level; the guide turns green.

PITCH_UNKNOWN.meaning: No pitch from sensors or background verticals; absolute heights, cm positions and angles are experimental
PITCH_UNKNOWN.unlockHint: Record in the app with motion access on, so we can level the picture.

SCALE_INCONSISTENT.meaning: Gravity-based and body-based scales disagree by more than 15%, or the estimated toss depth disagrees with its prior by more than 3 sigma
SCALE_INCONSISTENT.unlockHint: Check your height in Profile. If this was slow motion, import the original.

IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUE.meaning: A hard plausibility bound failed; value excluded and counted as not measured
IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUE.unlockHint: This reading looked wrong, so we left it out.

CHECK_THIS_SERVE.meaning: A soft plausibility bound failed; value kept with lower confidence
CHECK_THIS_SERVE.unlockHint: This one looks unusual. Check this serve?

TOO_FEW_SERVES.meaning: n below the minimum for this aggregate
TOO_FEW_SERVES.unlockHint: Record at least {n} serves from one side.

BASELINE_BUILDING.meaning: A player-relative band needs at least 2 matched sessions
BASELINE_BUILDING.unlockHint: Building your range: {k} of 2 sessions from this set-up.

RANGE_TOO_WIDE.meaning: Speed range wider than 35% of its midpoint
RANGE_TOO_WIDE.unlockHint: This footage can't pin the speed down closely enough.

EXPERIMENTAL_HIDDEN.unlockHint: Turn on experimental metrics in Profile to see this.

CONDITION_NOT_VALIDATED.meaning: Metric not yet validated for this light condition class
CONDITION_NOT_VALIDATED.unlockHint: Checked in daylight only. Under lights this reading is experimental.

NOT_MEASURABLE.unlockHint: Spin needs cameras shooting about 1,000 frames a second or a radar tracker; phone video can't measure it. Log the serve type you meant instead.

LOW_LIGHT.meaning: Exposure or backlight too poor for pose
LOW_LIGHT.unlockHint: Put the sun or court lights behind the camera.

FLICKER.unlockHint: Under lights, record at 50 or 100 fps if your phone allows it.

MOTION_BLUR.meaning: Ball streak longer than 3 diameters near contact
MOTION_BLUR.unlockHint: More light, or a shorter shutter in the app's recorder.

UNMATCHED.unlockHint: Compare sessions from the same side, view, set-up and serve.

verdicts.at-measurement-limit: At the limit of what we can measure
verdicts.likely-better: Likely better. About {N} more serves to confirm
verdicts.too-early: Too early to tell. About {N} more serves would settle it
verdicts.likely-worse: Likely worse. About {N} more serves to confirm
verdicts.withinSessionCaveat: Same-session comparison: warm-up and tiredness can explain part of the difference.
verdicts.nCapText: More than 150 serves; this difference is too small to confirm by counting. Watch toss spread and contact height instead.
verdicts.eligibility: Metric has a direction and emitted status measured or estimated on both sides in each side condition class; or a player-entered practice outcome rate with the same entry mode and serve number on both sides. Never experimental values, speed, bands, loading-depth, deep-bend-flag, drive-time, landing-distance, rear auto outcomes or the match log.
verdicts.effectSE: SE^2 = V1/n1 + V2/n2 + 2 sigma_s^2 + tau^2 (1/k1 + 1/k2); rates: Newcombe widened by tau_rate; spreads: stratified bootstrap of corrected variances, delta_rel = 1 - sqrt(Vc_follow / Vc_base).

looks.at: after follow-up sessions 1, 2 and 3, or when the planned N is reached; the third look is final
looks.basis: Pocock constants for 3 equally spaced looks (our computation: two-sided alpha 0.05 and 0.20)

planning.designEffect: Delta_shrunk = Delta x 4 SWC^2 / (4 SWC^2 + SE^2) (sceptical prior N(0, (2 SWC)^2)); Delta_design = max(SWC, |Delta_shrunk|)

enteredHeightM.basis: Adult range; ABS means 175.6 and 161.8 cm [N20]

apexHeightM.basis: An apex cannot be below a later point on the same flight

contactHeightRatio.basis: Published extremes 1.36-1.56; above 1.62 confirm entered height

tossForwardM.basis: Our inference: contact bounds applied to the toss

withinPlayerApexSdM.basis: Mixed strata, re-tosses or tracking swaps (session level)

withinPlayerRhythmSdS.basis: About 3 x the typical upper edge (session level)

fittedGravityMps2.basis: Wrong slow-motion time base or entered height; per toss excludes timing and cm values; a session median outside the hard range triggers section 2.9 or SCALE_INCONSISTENT

legDrivePctHeight.basis: Our inference; CoM rise 15.8 +/- 3.4% in professionals [G8]

plausibility.caughtTosses: retoss class: counted as tosses caught, excluded from contact and drop metrics, apex shown only as a separate figure, never in toss-height-spread
plausibility.sessionBlockRule: More than 20% hard rejects in a block makes the block statistics unavailable (IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUE)

provisionalBands.rules: Stratify (view, set-up, serve number, type, court side; sex for the drop); compute on the session median or corrected SD over >= 8 included serves (>= 12 for spreads in F3); hysteresis by the stated margin; words tight/typical/scattered, never good/bad; player-relative first.

adoption.contact-height-ratio: adopted (kick/2nd low edge 1.35; ages 60+ or overhead discomfort player-relative only)
adoption.landing-distance: rejected for display (no literature; trend only)

provisionalBands.triggerStatisticsOwner: Engine computes; COACHING decides (D6). coaching-library.json thresholds should align (METRICS.md 4.10, 7 flag 9).

metrics.name: Serves
metrics.question: How many serves did I hit?
metrics.referenceNote: No reference needed. Volume feeds load-flag (research 03 [S43]).

validation.syntheticTruth: canonical['serve-count'] (serves whose contact lies in the clip)
validation.syntheticThreshold: precision and recall >= 99% across families including S11 mirrors; 100% on S0
validation.realMethod: Two annotators count serves on >= 300 real serves

metrics.name: Re-tosses
metrics.question: How often did I catch a bad toss?
metrics.referenceNote: None. Caught tosses are excluded from contact and drop metrics and from toss-height-spread.

validation.syntheticThreshold: >= 95% correctly classified; 0 shadow swings counted
validation.realMethod: Annotator labels on real clips

metrics.name: Toss height
metrics.question: How high do I toss?

referenceRange.population: High-performance men, mean UTR about 10.7, n = 10

references.population: Nationally ranked junior men, 181 cm, n = 13 (about 1.88 x height)
Competitive women, serves in (about 2.1 x height)

metrics.referenceNote: Recreational players are not systematically lower than elite players; women toss higher relative to stature. Context only, never a target.
metrics.depthCorrection: ratio_corr = r_h + (ratio - r_h) x (1 - delta_hat / D); delta_hat from geometry.depthOffsetPriorsM.tossApex, combined with the per-session gravity estimate when available
metrics.uncertainty: Random: fit (+ extrapolation). Leak: sideways scatter 0.15 m. Shared: floor, body height 1.5%, pitch 0.5%/deg, focal. Persistent: body height 2.5%, entered height 1.2%, depth prior. 95% band about +/-23 cm against norms.

validation.syntheticTruth: canonical['toss-apex-height'] (metrics.tossApexHeightM / player.heightM); toss offsets 0-0.4 m both signs
validation.syntheticThreshold: median |error| <= 2.5% of height; p95 <= 5%; 95% coverage >= 93%
validation.realMethod: V2 annotated apex frame and ball; V3 4 m calibration pole in the server plane
validation.realThreshold: V2 MAE <= 3% of height; V3 MAE <= 10 cm, ICC(2,1) >= 0.75

metrics.name: Toss in front
metrics.question: Is my toss in front of me?
metrics.referenceNote: Recreational players toss close to the baseline; forward placement separates levels better than height. Coaching: toss into the court; drill target 30-50 cm (research 04 F3). Flat contact about 17 cm further forward than kick (research 03 [S35]).

display.example: about 35 cm in front of your front toe

metrics.uncertainty: Random: x-fit, S0 toe 0.021 BH. Leak: sideways scatter. Shared: scale 1.5%, toe bias 0.015 BH, yaw. Persistent: scale, depth prior. 95% band about +/-12 cm.

validation.syntheticThreshold: MAE <= 5 cm; p95 <= 10 cm; coverage >= 93%; S11 mirrors hold S0 thresholds
validation.realMethod: V2 annotated apex and toe; V3 two-view triangulation
validation.realThreshold: V2 MAE <= 6 cm; V3 MAE <= 8 cm

metrics.name: Toss left-right
metrics.question: Does my toss drift left or right?
metrics.referenceNote: Coaching: about '1 o'clock' for a right-hander; a toss directly overhead is a coaching concern for the shoulder (research 03 [S1]).

display.example: about 15 cm to your hitting side

validation.syntheticTruth: lateral apex offset from frontToeAtRelease, signed to the hitting side
validation.syntheticThreshold: MAE <= 5 cm
validation.realMethod: V3 two-view triangulation

metrics.name: Ball drop before contact
metrics.question: How far does the ball fall before I hit it?
metrics.statusTargetCondition: measured only for serves with sigma_dt <= 8 ms (120 fps, opt-in audio or ball-intersection); otherwise estimated at every level
metrics.referenceNote: Show both sexes. No direction is better. The drop is sex-dependent even at elite level; the earlier single 100 cm flag is withdrawn. Drop did not differ between serves in and faults in two samples.

triggerStatistics.f4Possible: median drop in the high band AND >= 1 co-signal
triggerStatistics.f4Likely: drop > 1.20 m (male) or > 1.45 m (female, not given) AND >= 2 co-signals
coSignals: hitting-wrist high point to contact > 0.55 s (experimental) or trophy-pause > 500 ms
contact-height-ratio > 0.04 below the player best matched median
observations: contact on the rise (contact before the fitted apex)

metrics.verdictUse: did-it-work only with a targetBand from COACHING
metrics.uncertainty: Physics path: sigma = g x dt x sigma_dt, per-serve sigma_dt (about 5 cm at 60 fps audio off, 1.4 cm with opt-in audio). Image path is a cross-check.

validation.syntheticThreshold: MAE <= 5 cm at 60 fps audio off, <= 3 cm at >= 120 fps; time MAE <= 13 ms at 60 fps; coverage >= 93%
validation.realMethod: V2 annotated apex and contact frames; V3 240 fps reference camera

metrics.name: Toss height consistency
metrics.question: Is my toss becoming more consistent (height)?

referenceRange.population: Professional women, within-player SD at zenith (vertical), n = 8 players x 5 serves

metrics.referenceNote: Authors judged a perfectly repeatable toss too strict a demand. Experienced servers stabilise the vertical dimension most (research 03 [S29]). No within-player recreational values. Side view: sideways scatter leaks into apparent height (2.4-3.7 cm per 10 cm of scatter); it is reported, not subtracted.
metrics.requiredCopy: Includes a small side-to-side component unless you add the rear view.
metrics.noiseCorrection: SD = sqrt(max(SD_obs^2 - mean(sigma_r^2), 0)); sigma_r = tracking and timing noise only (never sigma_leak); CI from chi-square bounds of the observed SD transformed with sigma_r x 0.8-1.2

triggerStatistics.f3Likely: one-sided 90% lower bound of the corrected SD >= 15 cm, n >= 12, >= 80% of serves detected
triggerStatistics.f3Possible: point estimate in the scattered band, bound not met
triggerStatistics.f3PlayerRelative: >= 50% rise vs the player best matched session at n >= 20

aggregation.ci: chi-square transformed (pooled within-session SD for multi-session baselines)

validation.syntheticTruth: canonical['toss-height-spread'] (SD of realised apex heights over the same serves)
validation.syntheticThreshold: |error| <= max(1.5 cm, 15%) in >= 90% of 20-serve blocks, leak reported separately; monotonic in sdScale; S12 censoring rule reproduces "at least"
validation.realMethod: V2 cross-day test-retest (sessions >= 2 days apart); V3 two-view triangulated SD
validation.realThreshold: V2 typical error <= 25% of median spread; V3 within 20% (then measured)

metrics.name: Toss front-back consistency
metrics.question: Is my toss landing in the same place front-to-back?

referenceRange.population: Professional women, within-player forward/back SD at zenith, n = 8 x 5

metrics.referenceNote: Experienced servers allow more forward-back variation than vertical (research 03 [S29]). Contact-forward SDs 12-13 cm in hobby men, median 8 cm in competitive men (research 05 [S47]). Residual yaw leaks sideways scatter into forward spread (reported, not subtracted).

triggerStatistics.f3Likely: one-sided 90% lower bound of the corrected SD >= 18 cm, n >= 12, >= 80% detected

validation.syntheticThreshold: |error| <= max(2 cm, 20%) in >= 90% of 20-serve blocks; monotonic in sdScale; S11 mirrors within threshold
validation.realMethod: As toss-height-spread

metrics.name: Toss side-to-side consistency
metrics.question: Is my toss landing in the same place side to side?

referenceRange.population: Professional women, within-player lateral SD at zenith, n = 8 x 5

metrics.referenceNote: Forward scatter leaks into lateral spread from behind (reported, not subtracted).

validation.syntheticTruth: SD of the realised lateral apex offset
validation.syntheticThreshold: |error| <= max(2 cm, 20%)
validation.realMethod: V3 two-view triangulated SD

metrics.name: Contact height
metrics.question: How high do I make contact?
metrics.referenceNote: Direction of travel, not a target. Between-player SD within a level is as large as the gap between levels. Impact height correlates with serve speed (rho 0.75-0.78; research 03 [S28]).

provisionalBands.playerRelativeOnly: profile.ageBand 60+ or overhead shoulder discomfort noted

triggerStatistics.f12Likely: median < low edge AND one-sided 90% upper bound incl. sigma_s and sigma_p < 1.42, >= 8 serves
triggerStatistics.f12Possible: median < low edge without the bound
triggerStatistics.f12PlayerRelative: fall >= 0.04 vs the player best matched median

metrics.uncertainty: Random: contact timing x ball speed (about 4.4 cm at 60 fps audio off), fit. Leak: sideways scatter. Body-height bias dominates absolute values (about 6.4 cm 1-sigma at 1.75 m) and cancels in the player own comparisons.

validation.syntheticThreshold: MAE <= 0.03 at 60 fps audio off, <= 0.02 at >= 120 fps; p95 <= 0.05; coverage >= 93%
validation.realMethod: V2 annotated contact frame and ball; V3 pole or 240 fps reference

metrics.name: Contact height consistency
metrics.question: Do I hit the ball at the same height each time?

referenceRange.population: Professional women, impact height within-player SD, n = 8 x 5

metrics.referenceNote: Hobby men 2.9-3.6 cm, competitive men median 4.1 cm (research 05 [S47]). At 60 fps audio off sigma_r (about 4.4 cm) is near plausible spreads, so the value is often nearMeasurementLimit.

validation.syntheticTruth: SD of canonical['contact-height-ratio'] x height over the same serves
validation.syntheticThreshold: |error| <= max(1.2 cm, 15%) at >= 120 fps; nearMeasurementLimit flagged at 60 fps when truth SD < 1.4 sigma_r
validation.realMethod: As toss-height-spread

metrics.name: Contact in front
metrics.question: Am I hitting the ball out in front?
metrics.referenceNote: Flat contact about 17 cm further forward than kick (research 03 [S35]). Coaching: contact in front and into the court (research 04 F6, F11). No direction; read with toss-forward.

provisionalBands.use: descriptive D3 feature only; no standalone fault

metrics.verdictUse: did-it-work only with a targetBand from COACHING

display.example: about 40 cm in front of your front toe

validation.syntheticThreshold: MAE <= 6 cm; p95 <= 12 cm; coverage >= 93%; S11 mirrors hold
validation.realMethod: V2 annotation; V3 two-view triangulation
validation.realThreshold: V2 MAE <= 6 cm; V3 MAE <= 10 cm

metrics.name: Toss-to-hit time
metrics.question: How long from toss to hit?

references.population: Recreational young adults and adults over 60 (derived)

metrics.referenceNote: No correct tempo; any ideal is coaching interpretation (research 05 section 6.2). Physics predicts 0.77-1.21 s across non-elite toss geometries.
metrics.verdictUse: did-it-work only with a targetBand from COACHING
metrics.uncertainty: sqrt(sigma_release^2 + sigma_contact^2): about 21 ms at 60 fps audio off.

validation.syntheticThreshold: MAE <= 1 frame + 5 ms (audio off); coverage >= 93%
validation.realMethod: V2 annotated release and contact frames

metrics.name: Rhythm consistency
metrics.question: Is my rhythm the same every serve?
metrics.referenceNote: Elite women: variable toss but very consistent timing (research 03 [S24]). More variability went with lower speed and accuracy (research 03 [S30]). Experts rate rhythm reliably from 2D video (research 03 [S33]).

validation.syntheticTruth: SD of canonical['rhythm-release-to-contact'] over the same serves
validation.syntheticThreshold: |error| <= max(10 ms, 20%) at 60 fps; nearMeasurementLimit flagged at 30 fps; monotonic in sdScale
validation.realMethod: V2 cross-day test-retest

metrics.name: Pause at the top
metrics.question: Do I pause at the top?
metrics.referenceNote: No numeric reference; no direct measurement in recreational adults. Internal-rotation speed about 20% higher with no pause than after a 1.5 s pause (research 03 [S2], lab mechanism).

validation.syntheticThreshold: MAE <= 60 ms; Spearman >= 0.8 across profiles; with section 1.2 noise injected
validation.realMethod: V2 two annotators mark trophy start and end
validation.realThreshold: MAE <= 80 ms after inter-rater agreement is reported

metrics.name: Leg drive (hip rise)
metrics.question: Am I using my legs?
metrics.formula: 100 x (h_mid(t_contact) - h_mid(t_low)), h_mid = (y_floor - y_midhip) / H_HU on rectified coordinates; t_low = lowest mid-hip in [tossRelease, contact - 0.08 s] (raw minimum, used even when the trophy fell back)

secondary.peakHipSpeedMps: experimental: peak upward mid-hip speed between t_low and contact (local quadratic over 7-9 frames)

band.reference: median of session medians over >= 2 matched sessions (>= 8 serves each); rolling last 6

metrics.referenceNote: The professional centre-of-mass rise 15.8 +/- 3.4% of height [G8] and 15-17.5% in national and provincial women [G9] are CoM rises, not mid-hip rises: never used as a band, target or comparison. Recreational hip rise is unverified. Coaching: a quick single rise, never "jump" or "bend more".
metrics.higherIsBetterNote: direction of travel, never a target

display.example: your hips rose about 12% of your height (about 21 cm) from your lowest point to contact

metrics.uncertainty: Per serve sigma_r = sqrt(2 sigma_hip^2 + (v_hip sigma_tc)^2), sigma_hip = 0.02 BH: about 3% of height; plus a posture-dependent persistent bias 1-2% (hips frontal at trophy, profile at contact). Session median at n = 12: about 1% random.

validation.syntheticThreshold: per-serve MAE <= 2% of height at 60 fps with measured hip noise; coverage >= 93%; peakHipSpeedMps within +/-0.25 m/s at 60 fps; S11 mirrors unchanged
validation.realMethod: V2 annotated hip centres at lowest and contact frames; V3 two synchronised phones or IMUs
validation.realThreshold: V2 MAE <= 2.5% of height; V3 within 2% of height

metrics.name: Drive time
metrics.question: How quickly do I drive up to the ball?
metrics.formula: (t_contact - t_trophy) x 1000, t_trophy = pelvis-min trophy (lowest mid-hip)

references.population: ITN 3 players, CoM lowest to impact (leg-drive duration 260 +/- 70 ms)

metrics.referenceNote: Different event definitions; context only, never a target. Trend only: no direction, no Did it work? verdict.
metrics.verdictUse: trend only (quicker / about the same / slower)

display.example: 0.38 s from your lowest point to contact

metrics.uncertainty: sqrt(sigma_trophy^2 + sigma_contact^2): about 47 ms at 60 fps.

validation.syntheticThreshold: MAE <= 50 ms at 60 fps; coverage >= 93%
validation.realMethod: V2 annotated lowest-hip and contact frames

metrics.name: Loading (hip dip)
metrics.question: How far do my hips dip as I load?

secondary.hipDipCount: experimental: mid-hip local minima in [motionStart, contact - 0.08 s] with prominence >= 3 x measured cleaned mid-hip noise (initial 0.03 BH), >= 0.25 s apart (double knee bend pattern, F10)

metrics.referenceNote: CoM drop 5.5 +/- 2.3% of height in professionals, between-player CV 42%, not related to racket speed or impact height [G8]. Depth is not the goal (gap: coaches T1). No direction, targetBand, SWC, verdict or population band.

display.example: clear dip: your hips dropped about 6% of your height as you loaded

metrics.uncertainty: About 3% of height per serve; about 1% for a session median at n = 12.

validation.syntheticThreshold: MAE <= 2% of height; two-level agreement >= 85% on session medians >= 1% from the cut; hipDipCount exact on >= 90% of double-dip renders
validation.realMethod: V2 annotated hip centres at release and lowest frames

metrics.name: Deep bend (experimental)
metrics.question: Did I bend deeply at the top?
metrics.formula: E4: theta = acos(min(1, e_thigh / L_thigh)) + acos(min(1, e_shank / L_shank)) for the geometric front leg at trophy (+/- 2 frames); vertical extents at the ankle depth; lengths from standing frames
metrics.gateBeforeV1: Re-simulate with the measured ROI noise; if two-level error > 15%, the flag is not built (NOT_IMPLEMENTED).
metrics.referenceNote: About 14% of serves wrong on two levels under the gap noise model; cannot separate little from moderate (57% wrong at a true 10 deg). Never a "bend more" cue; may be mentioned next to leg-drive (deep bend, slow rise).

validation.syntheticThreshold: two-level error <= 15% across knee azimuths 0-60 deg (gap test 1); false yes <= 10% on truths below 35 deg
validation.realMethod: V3 two synchronised phones or IMUs

metrics.name: Shoulder tilt at the top
metrics.question: How much do my shoulders tilt at the top?

bandRule.angle: phi = atan2(y_B - y_F, netDir x (x_F - x_B) x aspect) at trophy on rectified keypoints, median over +/- 2 frames; F = front shoulder (larger netDir.x); positive = front shoulder higher
bandRule.reference: median of session medians over >= 2 matched sessions (same stratum incl. setupClass and court side), >= 8 serves each; rolling last 6; s_p = pooled within-session SD
bandRule.sessionTypicalHalfWidthDeg: max(5, 2 x SE), SE = 1.25 s_p / sqrt(n)

secondary.sideBendTrophy: experimental, never displayed: 2D angle between shoulder line and hip line

metrics.referenceNote: Replaces trunk-tilt-band. The shoulder line is 16-31 deg from the side image plane at trophy (projection +1 to +4 deg). No population degrees: never compared with 25 +/- 7.1 deg or 48 deg (D5). Possible upward shift of the front shoulder from the raised tossing arm (unverified) cancels player-relative. No targetBand; COACHING must not infer back load from it. Kovacs: shoulder and pelvis lateral rear tilt during loading (research 03 [S1]).

display.example: Your usual tilt on 10 of 12 serves

validation.syntheticThreshold: rectified 2D within +/-4 deg of 3D on S0 (gap test 4); within 1 deg of the level render across the tilt family (gap test 3); band agreement >= 85% for injected +/-10 deg shifts; S11 mirrors keep the sign
validation.realMethod: Two blinded coaches label less / usual / more against the player earlier clips

metrics.name: Knee bend
metrics.question: How much do my knees bend at the top?

bandThresholds.unit: deg 2D knee flexion of the nearer (back) knee at trophy, rear view, rectified

method.rear: nearer knee (the leg whose ankle sits lower in the rectified image); never the front knee; ambiguous or visibility < 0.6 -> unclear

sideView.unlockHint: Add a phone behind you to see this.
sideView.why: Knees point at the side camera at trophy; a raw 2D angle puts 47-80% of serves in the wrong band (gap: geometry 3.3).

metrics.referenceNote: Knee restriction to 10 deg cut ball speed about 15-17% at all levels (research 03 [S7]). Low front-knee flexion and arm load: conflicting evidence (research 03 [S3], [S9]). The pooled front-knee 64.5 +/- 9.7 deg is not used (a different knee, 3D). Degrees are never displayed (D5). No targetBand: never a "bend more" target; may only support a leg-drive focus.
metrics.expectedError: about 11-13% wrong band, 0% little/deep swaps (gap noise model); 21% with doubled noise

display.example: Moderate bend on 9 of 12 serves (rear view)

validation.syntheticTruth: canonical['knee-bend-band'] (band of the back knee 3D flexion at trophy; alt.backKneeAtTrophy3DDeg)
validation.syntheticThreshold: >= 85% agreement where truth is >= 5 deg from a cut point; 0 little/deep swaps; unclear <= 25%; platform stance -> unclear; side view never bands
validation.realMethod: Two blinded coaches label three levels on rear clips

metrics.name: Shoulder over shoulder at contact
metrics.question: Do my shoulders tilt up into the hit?

bandRule.angle: phi_c = atan2(y_t - y_h, hitDir x (x_h - x_t) x aspect) at contact (+/- 1 frame), rectified rear coordinates; S_h = shoulder on the geometric hitting wrist side; positive = hitting shoulder higher

sideView.why: At contact the shoulder line is 65-84 deg out of the side plane; a true 48 deg reads 69-84 deg (gap: geometry 4.2).

metrics.referenceNote: Kovacs shoulder-over-shoulder (research 03 [S1]); the published 48 deg has an unresolved definition and is never compared; Reid et al. 3D side tilt at impact 41.7 +/- 7.8 (flat) and 33.4 +/- 10.2 deg (kick) is context only.

display.example: Your usual tilt at contact (rear view, experimental)

validation.syntheticThreshold: rectified 2D within +/-4 deg of 3D (gap test 4); band agreement >= 85% for injected +/-10 deg shifts
validation.realMethod: V3 two-view check
validation.realThreshold: within 4 deg of the triangulated angle

metrics.name: Landing distance
metrics.question: Am I driving into the court?
metrics.statusDefaultCondition: Experimental until V1 passes with measured foot-point noise and geometric foot identification (S11); then estimated for the player-relative displacement from S0 only.
metrics.referenceNote: No norms for any population (gap: ranges 5). Measured from where the front toe started, not from the baseline. Trend only; not a fault trigger (no "<= 0 cm" flag, not used for F18). Population bands rejected until the gap: ranges 9 reference set exists. Coaching: landing behind the baseline suggests no forward drive (research 04 F9).
metrics.verdictUse: trend only (further in / about the same / further back)

display.example: you land about 45 cm in front of where your front toe started

metrics.uncertainty: Random: S0 toe 0.021 BH and landing toe about 0.021 BH, landing-foot identification. Shared: scale 1.5%, yaw. 95% band about +/-12 cm.

validation.syntheticThreshold: with measured foot noise: MAE <= 8 cm; p95 <= 15 cm; coverage >= 93%; landing time MAE <= 1.5 frames; S11 whole and leg-only mirrors hold
validation.realMethod: V2 heel and toe annotation at release and landing; V3 tape-measured chalk marks
validation.realThreshold: V2 MAE <= 6 cm; V3 MAE <= 10 cm

metrics.name: Serve shape repeatability
metrics.question: How similar are my serves to each other?
metrics.referenceNote: Our own composite; no external reference. More variable movement went with lower speed and accuracy (research 03 [S30]).

validation.syntheticThreshold: Spearman >= 0.9 vs sdScale per profile with measured noise; seeds at equal sdScale within 5 points; S11 within 5 points
validation.realMethod: Correlation with coach-rated consistency; test-retest
validation.realThreshold: to be set after V2 pilot

metrics.name: Serves in
metrics.question: How many serves went in?
metrics.verdictUse: did-it-work from your tags (same entry mode and serve number; not match log; not rear auto)
metrics.referenceNote: See first-serve-in-rate and second-serve-in-rate for level data.

validation.syntheticTruth: n/a for player entry; rear auto: flight bounce vs service box
validation.syntheticThreshold: rear auto >= 95% correct for bounces > 30 cm from lines
validation.realMethod: Rear auto vs annotated video plus on-court observer
validation.realThreshold: >= 95% for bounces > 30 cm from lines (research 05 section 11.3)

metrics.name: First serves in
metrics.question: Am I getting more first serves in?
metrics.verdictUse: did-it-work from your tags (same entry mode and serve number; not match log; not rear auto)

referenceRange.population: SwingVision users, NTRP 3.0-5.0, match play, combined genders, 250,000+ sessions

metrics.referenceNote: D11 headline outcome. First-serve % barely moves with level, so it is a weak progress headline (research 09 section 4.1). Detecting a 10-point rise needs about 480 serves per side at 80% power.

validation.syntheticThreshold: n/a
validation.realMethod: As serve-in-rate (rear auto)

metrics.verdictUse: did-it-work from your tags (same entry mode and serve number; not match log; not rear auto)

referenceRange.population: SwingVision users, NTRP 3.0-5.0, match play, combined genders

metrics.name: Double faults
metrics.question: How many double faults?

sources.secondServeBlock: default v1 path: every serve is a 2nd serve (sequence rule off); DF = faulted second serves; rate = DF / second serves x 10; no point play needed
sources.tally: DF entered directly, or derived from the tally second-serve faults
sources.pointPlay: optional, deferred in v1: a 2nd serve with a fault; rate per 10 points (points = 1st serves)
sources.matchLog: D11 match log count per match, provenance match-log, never pooled with practice, no verdicts

metrics.referenceNote: D11 headline pain. Match play, not practice.

aggregation.ci: wilson (DF / second serves, or DF / points)

metrics.verdictUse: did-it-work from your tags on the practice rate per second serve (same entry mode)

validation.syntheticThreshold: n/a
validation.realMethod: n/a (player-entered)

metrics.name: Where serves land
metrics.question: Where are my serves landing?
metrics.zoneDefinition: Service box width (4.115 m) split into thirds; the third nearest the centre line is T [Our inference]. Too close to call when P(zone) < 0.8.
metrics.targetTagUse: The per-serve target tag is also entry:targetZone for speed-experimental (D4).
metrics.referenceNote: No recreational reference. Placement, closeness to lines and speed classified professional aces with 87% accuracy (research 03 [S21]).

display.example: T 6, body 3, wide 4; 8 of 13 on target

validation.syntheticThreshold: rear auto zone agreement >= 90%
validation.realMethod: Rear auto vs annotated video and observer

metrics.name: Serve types
metrics.question: Which serves did I practise?
metrics.referenceNote: None. Intended type is a stratum key and selects the depth-offset prior.

validation.syntheticThreshold: n/a
validation.realMethod: n/a

metrics.name: Launch speed (experimental)
metrics.question: Roughly how fast was that serve off the racket?
metrics.trackRequirements: >= 3 clean outgoing detections (score >= 0.15) 4-50 ms after contact; straight-line residual within the engine gate

method.name: Side-view outgoing track (estimateServeSpeedFromTrack, ball/speed.ts)

outOfPlaneDegByTag.source: ball/speed.ts TARGET_TAG_OUT_OF_PLANE_DEG: gap zone centres about 2/9/15 +/- 4 deg widened for stance, zone spread and +/-2 deg camera aim (yaw allowance); a measured yaw shifts the band and narrows it by up to 2 deg

method.depthChangeAlongTrack: signed: ball moves sin(psi) m per m travelled; with a chest-side camera away from it when serving from the court half nearer the camera (deuce for a right-hander) and towards it from the far half (ad); back-side camera flips; correction at the window mid-time over the tag psi band, band width in the range (engine flag: speed.ts treats it symmetrically)
method.audio: never used for speed; audio only times contact

removedMethods: B: audio flight time (removed 2026-09-27, D4: bounce out of frame, about +/-20% error)
metrics.referenceNote: Context only: SwingVision average first-serve speed 96-120 km/h at NTRP 3.0-5.0 (research 01 [S7], vendor claim; average reads about 20% below radar, research 05 [S35]). Lab radar flat first serves: beginners 107, intermediates 149 km/h (research 03 [S7]). Never combined with speed-average-rear. No Did it work? verdicts.

aggregation.ci: shared relative error (2 sigma, not averaged) plus random / sqrt(n)

validation.syntheticThreshold: range coverage >= 90% (target 95%) separately on deuce and ad; median |midpoint error| <= 5%; unavailable in 100% below 120 fps, untagged or physics-fixed time base
validation.realMethod: V3 radar (+/-1 mph class) behind the server in line with the serve; 200+ serves

metrics.name: Average speed to the bounce (experimental)
metrics.question: Roughly how fast was that serve over its flight?

method.name: Contact to a bounce located in rear-view video (speedFromFlightTime, ball/speed.ts)
method.flightTime: bounce time minus contact time, both from video; audio may refine each time only when an onset is within +/-2 sigma of the video time, after removing its own sound delay (bounce distance from the located bounce via the homography)
method.path: chord from the contact region (server feet through the homography, contact height from the ratio x H_m when available) to the located bounce +/- 2 sigma, x arc factor 1.005-1.02
method.errorBudget: about 2.6% median, 6.1% at the 90th percentile (bounce +/-0.3 m, onset 5 ms; gap: geometry 7.3)
method.resolution: Ball about 4 px (1080p) to 7 px (4K) at the far service line, below the 8 px detection threshold: 4K recommended
method.sessionCoverageGate: session typical unavailable (BOUNCE_NOT_LOCATED) when bounces are located on < 50% of serves that went in; per-serve ranges remain
method.audioOnly: never: a bounce sound without a located bounce is refused

metrics.referenceNote: Average speed reads about 20% below a radar peak (research 05 [S35]). SwingVision average first-serve speed 96-120 km/h at NTRP 3.0-5.0 (vendor claim). Never combined with speed-experimental (D1). No Did it work? verdicts.

aggregation.ci: shared relative error (2 sigma) plus random / sqrt(n)

display.example: about 115-125 km/h (average speed to the bounce, experimental)

validation.syntheticThreshold: coverage >= 90%; median |midpoint error| <= 4%; located-bounce rate reported at 1080p and 4K; unavailable in 100% of side-view clips
validation.realMethod: V3 synchronised 240 fps second camera for contact and bounce times; radar logged for context

metrics.name: Radar speed (you logged)
metrics.question: What did my radar say?
metrics.referenceNote: Pairs with speed-experimental (launch vs radar peak) become personal validation data; pairs with speed-average-rear are shown as average vs peak, not a containment check.

validation.syntheticThreshold: n/a
validation.realMethod: n/a (player-entered)

metrics.name: Spin
metrics.question: How much spin did I use?
metrics.referenceNote: Serve spin is about 1,000-5,000 rpm (research 05 [S43]); at 240 fps the ball turns 75-125 deg between frames; even Hawk-Eye estimates had an error SD of about 540 rpm (research 05 [S44]).

display.example: Spin needs cameras shooting about 1,000 frames a second or a radar tracker; phone video can't measure it. Log the serve type you meant instead.

validation.syntheticThreshold: must be unavailable in 100% of cases
validation.realMethod: n/a

metrics.name: Capture quality
metrics.question: Can I trust this session's numbers?

level.block: > 5 deg (8 after the tilt test) or yaw > 15 deg

rules.usable: any warning and >= 70% of serves analysable
rules.poor: a session-level block (view, time-base, fps) or < 50% of serves analysable

metrics.referenceNote: Adapted from research 06 section 14; thresholds are initial. CAPTURE section 8 owns how checks are computed live; METRICS owns the status mapping.

display.example: Fair: toss left the frame on 3 of 12 serves

validation.syntheticTruth: extra truth captureQuality block and scenario tags
validation.syntheticThreshold: each flag fires with >= 95% sensitivity in its trigger scenario; <= 5% false alarms on S0
validation.realMethod: Flag review on V2 sessions

metrics.name: Fatigue check
metrics.question: Did my serve drop off as I got tired?
metrics.rule: Per block, never across a drill or template-block boundary. Theil-Sen slope of contact-height-ratio on serve order; predicted drop over the block >= 0.025 of height and one-sided 95% bootstrap bound of the slope < 0. Confidence 0.6, or 0.8 if toss-height-spread in the last third >= 1.5 x the first third.
metrics.referenceNote: Context: after a 3-hour match, advanced players impact height fell about 4 cm (2.65 to 2.61 m) (research 03 [S14]; research 05 [S50]). A practice block is not a 3-hour match.

display.example: Your contact point dropped in the last part of this block, which can be a sign of tiring. A shorter block next time?

validation.syntheticTruth: scenario with an injected linear contact-height decline
validation.syntheticThreshold: fires >= 90% when the decline >= 0.035 of height over 20 serves; <= 5% false alarms with no decline; 0% across a drill boundary
validation.realMethod: n/a in v1

metrics.name: Serving volume check
metrics.question: Am I ramping up my serving too fast?
metrics.rule: Uncoupled ratio: acute = serves in the last 7 days; chronic = weekly mean over days 8-35. Flag when ratio > 1.5 and acute >= 100 serves. Counts = serve-count plus player-entered match serves (match log); prompt for a match serve count in weeks with a logged comp match.
metrics.statusCopy: based on the serves you filmed and logged
metrics.referenceNote: Ratio above 1.5 went with a hazard ratio of about 2.8 for new injury in adult high-performance players (research 03 [S43]); the coupled ratio is contested; transfer to recreational players is our inference.

display.example: Based on the serves you filmed and logged, you've served a lot more this week than usual. Build up gradually.

validation.syntheticThreshold: unit tests incl. < 28 days not computed
validation.realMethod: n/a
